glosses: to fly (to travel through the air)

o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish اوچمق (uçmaq), from Proto-Turkic *uč- (“to fly”).

Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish اوچماق (uçmaq), واچماغ (uçmağ), from Proto-Turkic *uštmag, from Sogdian [script needed] (ʼwštmʼχ, “paradise”). Sogdian borrowing underwent a semantic merge with uçmaq (“to fly”), thence the parallels.
Cognate with Kazakh ұжмақ (ujmaq), Southern Altai учмак (učmak), etc. Doublet of behişt.

From Proto-Turkic *yak-
Cognate with Turkish yakmak, Chuvash ҫот (śot), etc.
